note: Phase 2, measurement A for the local-layer plan (M10): memories that matter but are wrong. Each question's answer is only in the remembered facts. Conditions: clean (the correct fact among the filler), replaced (an older dated fact on the same subject beside the newer one), person (the same attribute for another person or thing), near (the same person or thing, a neighbouring attribute that does not answer). Each distractor carries the pattern its own wrong answer matches, so a reply that gives it can be told from a plain miss. All names, places and facts are invented. kind and want are graded by scripts/phase-1/quiz.py; every question carries its tail. The filler is the first 20 facts about books, hobbies, teams, houseplants and instruments from the M10 run's set of 300 (docs/phase-2.md, section 9), chosen because no question asks about those subjects.
